If the total number of pages printed by all the given printers together on Monday was 15% more than the total number of pages printed by all the given printers together on Friday, then what was the total number of pages printed by all the given printers together on Monday
solution:
**Given:**

The table shows the number of pages printed by four printers over three days. We need to find the total number of pages printed by all the printers on Monday.

**Concept:**

The total number of pages printed by all the printers on Monday is 15% more than the total number of pages printed by all the printers on Friday.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total number of pages printed by all printers on Friday = 880 + 885 + 877 + 898

⇒ Total on Friday = 880 + 885 + 877 + 898

⇒ Total on Friday = 3540

⇒ Increase in total pages on Monday = 15% of total pages on Friday

⇒ Increase on Monday = 15/100 × 3540

⇒ Increase on Monday = 531

⇒ Total number of pages printed on Monday = Total pages on Friday + Increase on Monday

⇒ Total on Monday = 3540 + 531

⇒ Total on Monday = 4071

**∴ The total number of pages printed by all the printers together on Monday is 4071.**
